**新方向：ACE05 Event Extraction 扩展（D040，conference main 目标）**

目标：证明 OntoCoDec 不仅适用于 RE，还适用于 Event Extraction，升级 contribution 为通用 ontology-constrained structured generation framework。

**四张卡全部利用。以下工作立即开始：**

---

**Step 1：ACE05 数据和 Schema 准备（今天完成）**

1. **获取 ACE05 数据集**：
   - 检查 westd-16980 和 westd-21461 上是否已有 ACE05 数据
   - 如果没有，从 HuggingFace 或其他来源下载 ACE05 event extraction 数据（常用的是 ACE05-E+ 或 OneIE 预处理版本）
   - 需要：test set documents + gold event annotations

2. **定义 ACE05 event ontology schema**：
   创建 `data/ace05/ontology_constraints_ace05.json`，包含：
   - 33 event types（Attack, Transport, Die, Elect, ...）
   - 每个 event type 的 argument roles（如 Attack: Attacker, Target, Instrument, Place, Time）
   - 每个 argument role 的 entity type 约束（如 Attacker 必须是 PER/ORG，Target 可以是 PER/ORG/FAC/VEH/WEA）
   - 参考 ACE05 annotation guidelines 获取完整约束定义

3. **设计 JSON 输出格式**：
   ```json
   {
     "events": [
       {
         "trigger": "attacked",
         "event_type": "Conflict:Attack",
         "arguments": [
           {"text": "rebels", "role": "Attacker", "entity_type": "PER"},
           {"text": "the city", "role": "Target", "entity_type": "FAC"}
         ]
       }
     ]
   }
   ```

4. **编译 XGrammar CFG**：
   - 从 ontology schema 生成 JSON Schema（约束 event_type 为 33 个枚举值、role 为对应 event type 的有效 roles）
   - 编译 semantic masks（argument role → entity type 约束，类似 RE 的 domain/range）
   - 确保与现有 grammar layer + semantic layer 代码兼容

5. **设计 prompt template**：
   - 参考 SciERC/DocRED 的 prompt 格式
   - 系统 prompt 包含 event type 定义 + argument role 列表

---

**Step 2：代码适配**

1. 修改推理脚本支持 event extraction 输出格式
2. 写 `violation_checker_ace05.py`：
   - 检查 event_type 是否在枚举中（类似 RV）
   - 检查 argument role 是否对该 event type 有效（类似 DR）
   - 检查 entity_type 是否满足该 role 的约束（核心 semantic constraint）
   - 定义 violation 类别：ET（entity type）、RV（role vocabulary）、AC（argument constraint = 类似 DR）

3. 写评估脚本计算 event extraction F1（trigger identification + argument extraction）

---

**Step 3：Dry run（今天）**

在 westd-21461 上用 Mistral 跑 10 个文档的 dry run：
- unconstrained + constrained (full_s1)
- 验证：输出格式正确、violation checker 工作、grammar 编译成功

**时间表**：
- Step 1-2 今天完成
- Step 3 dry run 今天晚上
- 明天正式跑全量实验（3 模型 × 4 GPU 并行）

先开始 Step 1，有任何问题立即汇报。这是最高优先级任务。

\section{Effect of Document Length on Constraint Effectiveness}
\label{app:doc-length}

To examine whether OntoCoDec's constraint effectiveness varies with document complexity, we partition test documents into three length bins (tertile split by word count) and report per-bin violation counts and F1.

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\small
\caption{Document length breakdown on SciERC (Qwen3-8B). Tertile boundaries: Short $\leq$ 19 words, Medium $\leq$ 27, Long $>$ 27.}
\label{tab:doc-length-scierc}
\begin{tabular}{ll rrrrr rr}
\toprule
\textbf{Bin} & \textbf{Mode} & \textbf{ET} & \textbf{RV} & \textbf{DR} & \textbf{CF} & \textbf{Total} & \textbf{E-F1} & \textbf{R-F1} \\
\midrule
Short (196)  & Uncon. &  1 &  5 &  57 & 0 &  63 & 32.4 &  8.9 \\
             & Const. &  0 &  0 &   5 & 5 &  10 & 32.4 &  8.9 \\
\midrule
Medium (180) & Uncon. &  6 &  9 & 104 & 0 & 119 & 27.8 &  6.7 \\
             & Const. &  0 &  0 &   7 & 15 & 22 & 27.8 &  6.7 \\
\midrule
Long (175)   & Uncon. &  3 & 10 & 104 & 1 & 118 & 29.9 &  7.0 \\
             & Const. &  0 &  0 &   4 & 20 & 24 & 30.0 &  7.3 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\small
\caption{Document length breakdown on DocRED (Qwen3-8B). Tertile boundaries: Short $\leq$ 160 words, Medium $\leq$ 208, Long $>$ 208.}
\label{tab:doc-length-docred}
\begin{tabular}{ll rrrrr rr}
\toprule
\textbf{Bin} & \textbf{Mode} & \textbf{ET} & \textbf{RV} & \textbf{DR} & \textbf{CF} & \textbf{Total} & \textbf{E-F1} & \textbf{R-F1} \\
\midrule
Short (336)  & Uncon. & 177 & 1238 & 1021 &   9 & 2445 & 61.1 &  9.3 \\
             & Const. &   0 &    0 &  495 & 138 &  633 & 62.6 &  9.6 \\
\midrule
Medium (332) & Uncon. & 147 & 1742 & 1047 &   5 & 2941 & 59.3 &  7.9 \\
             & Const. &   0 &    5 &  544 & 180 &  729 & 60.7 &  8.5 \\
\midrule
Long (330)   & Uncon. & 176 & 2209 & 1162 &   3 & 3550 & 53.9 &  5.6 \\
             & Const. &   0 &    0 &  731 & 200 &  931 & 54.8 &  5.8 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\small
\caption{Violation reduction percentage by document length bin.}
\label{tab:doc-length-reduction}
\begin{tabular}{l rr rr}
\toprule
& \multicolumn{2}{c}{\textbf{SciERC}} & \multicolumn{2}{c}{\textbf{DocRED}} \\
\cmidrule(lr){2-3} \cmidrule(lr){4-5}
\textbf{Bin} & \textbf{Viols (U$\to$C)} & \textbf{Red.\%} & \textbf{Viols (U$\to$C)} & \textbf{Red.\%} \\
\midrule
Short  & 63 $\to$ 10  & 84.1 & 2445 $\to$ 633  & 74.1 \\
Medium & 119 $\to$ 22 & 81.5 & 2941 $\to$ 729  & 75.2 \\
Long   & 118 $\to$ 24 & 79.7 & 3550 $\to$ 931  & 73.8 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

The violation reduction rate is consistent across all length bins: 80--84\% for SciERC and 74--75\% for DocRED.
Longer documents produce more violations in the unconstrained setting (e.g., DocRED long-bin: 3,550 vs.\ short-bin: 2,445), yet OntoCoDec achieves proportionally similar reduction, confirming that the constraint framework scales reliably with document complexity.
ET and RV violations are fully eliminated across all bins.
F1 scores are preserved or slightly improved under constrained decoding, with DocRED showing +0.9--1.5 E-F1 and +0.2--0.6 R-F1 improvement in the constrained setting.

content.content: {"result":"{\"success\": true, \"data\": {\"path\": \"/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_6/projects/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/paper_framing.md\", \"content\": \"# OntoCoDec — Paper Framing\\n\\n## Target Venue\\nEMNLP 2026 (ARR submission May 25, 2026)\\n\\n## Title\\nOntoCoDec: Type-Valid Information Extraction via Compiled Ontology Constraints\\n(D015: \\\"Near-Complete\\\" dropped — DocRED residual DR=10.21% (Qwen) 不算 near-complete。论文贡献是方法，不是特定消除率。SciERC 0.93% 和 DocRED 2.55% (Llama) 可在正文中描述为 near-complete，但 title 不宜 overclaim。)\\n\\n## Core Insight\\nLLM-based IE systems produce systematic ontology constraint violations concentrated in specific relation types. Prompt-level intervention (schema-informed prompting) reduces violations by ~62% but cannot eliminate them — certain relation types retain 25-30% violation rates even with explicit constraint descriptions. OntoCoDec provides **near-complete elimination (DR 15.4%→0.93%, ↓94%) at zero or positive F1 impact** through automatic ontology-to-decoder constraint compilation with two complementary layers.\\n\\n**Phase 2 confirmed (D012 bootstrap CI, v2 fix)**: Grammar+Semantic dual-layer constrained decoding reduces domain/range violations by 94%, eliminates entity-type and relation-vocabulary violations entirely (→0%). F1 impact is **dataset-dependent**:\\n- SciERC: Rel F1 neutral (+0.13pp, p=0.58), Ent F1 neutral (-0.03pp, p=0.53)\\n- DocRED: Rel F1 **significantly improved** (+0.50pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.23, +0.81]); Ent F1 **significantly improved** (+1.23pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.94, +1.55])\\n- Mechanism: grammar 消除 OOV relation names (DocRED RV 29.66%→0.03%) + 非标 entity types (ET 2.48%→0%)。all_set F1 方法下 OOV=FP → fewer FP → higher precision/F1。SciERC baseline RV/ET 已很低，效果不显著。\\n- **Grammar 层是 F1 提升的唯一来源**: grammar_only Ent F1=59.38% ≈ full_s1 59.37% (Δ+0.01pp, p=0.66)。Semantic 层对 F1 无额外贡献，专注 DR reduction。\\n\\n## Core Claims\\n\\n### Claim 1 (Empirical): Violation Landscape\\nLLM-based IE systems violate ontology type constraints at non-trivial rates (15.4% per-triple on SciERC, 18.7% on DocRED). Violations are **not uniformly distributed** — they concentrate on relation types with tight domain/range constraints (Feature-of 33.5%, Compare 42.4%) while loose-constraint relations show near-zero violation (Used-for 0.8%).\\n\\n**Key insight**: Violation rate is driven by **constraint tightness**, not ontology size. A small ontology with tight constraints can produce more violations than a large ontology with loose constraints.\\n\\n**D014 修订**: DR reduction ceiling 由 **tightness × model RV baseline** 共同决定，非 tightness 单因素。Llama DocRED DR↓90.2% vs Qwen DR↓44.7%（同一 ontology τ̄=0.842）。机制：Qwen RV=29.66% >> Llama RV=16.03% → grammar 层将 OOV triples 强制匹配有效关系名 → 揭露大量 latent DR violations → 残余 DR 更高。这是比单一 tightness 更深的 insight。\\n\\n**Evidence**: SciERC (7 relations) 15.4%; DocRED (96 relations) 18.7% — comparable rates despite 14× ontology size difference. Schema-informed prompt on DocRED only achieves DR↓32% (vs SciERC ↓62%), confirming **prompt-level intervention scales poorly with ontology complexity**.\\n\\n### Claim 2 (Empirical): Prompt Insufficiency\\nSchema-informed prompting (explicitly describing domain/range constraints in the prompt) reduces but does not eliminate violations:\\n- Overall: 15.4% → 5.78% (-62.4%), still above 5%\\n- Per-relation: Compare 42.4% → 27.6%, Evaluate-for 24.1% → 29.9% (**worse**)\\n- Prompt intervention is unreliable at the per-relation level — some relations improve, one regresses\\n\\n**Narrative**: This is NOT about \\\"5.78% barely above 5%\\\". The story is: **prompt-level intervention is fundamentally unreliable as a guarantee mechanism**. It works statistically but cannot provide per-instance compliance. Three specific relation types retain >10% violation rates with schema-informed prompts. For safety-critical IE (biomedical, legal, regulatory), statistical reduction is insufficient — guaranteed compliance is required.\\n\\n### Claim 3 (Methodological): Composable Constraint Framework\\nOntoCoDec automatically compiles IE ontology schemas into two composable constraint layers:\\n1. **Grammar layer** (XGrammar): JSON structure + type vocabulary constraints (CFG-expressible)\\n2. **Semantic layer** (TypeConstraintProcessor): Cross-field domain/range constraints via stateful entity registry + dynamic logit masking\\n\\nThe two layers are **complementary with enabling dependency**: grammar ensures every generated relation type is in the valid vocabulary, which enables the semantic layer to look up and enforce domain/range rules for that type. Without grammar, the semantic layer encounters unknown relation types and cannot enforce constraints (explaining why semantic_only achieves only ↓24% vs full_s1 ↓94%). This is NOT \\\"synergistic\\\" (mutual amplification) — grammar is a prerequisite for semantic, not vice versa.\\n\\nThe two layers compose via bitwise AND of token masks. Recommended framing: \\\"Grammar and semantic constraints compose via bitwise AND with an enabling dependency: grammar ensures structural validity, enabling semantic constraints to enforce domain/range rules. When constraint tightness creates empty intersection between layers, the system degrades gracefully to grammar-only constraints, maintaining structural validity as a guaranteed floor.\\\"\\n\\n**Graceful degradation + Fallback 频率量化** (D008 + Reviewer 发现):\\nWhen $M_{semantic} \\\\cap M_{grammar} = \\\\emptyset$, the system falls back to grammar-only control.\\n\\n**关键量化数据（Reviewer 从日志挖掘）**:\\n- Llama DocRED full_s1: **32,921 次 fallback / 577 docs = ~57 次/doc**\\n- Llama SciERC full_s1: **5,882 次 fallback / 550 docs = ~10.7 次/doc**\\n- DocRED fallback 频率是 SciERC 的 **5.3×**\\n- Qwen DocRED fallback 率未知（日志当时无 fallback logging，需估算）\\n\\n**这直接解释了 DocRED DR 残余 10.19% vs SciERC 0.93%**: 更多 token 位置退化为 grammar-only → grammar-only 的 DR 已知为 26.17% → 高 fallback = 高残余 DR。\\n\\n**论文建议**: 在 §5 tightness 段报告 fallback 率，定义 \\\"Constraint Coverage\\\" 指标（semantic masking 实际生效的 token 比例）。这把 \\\"10.19% DR 残余\\\" 从弱点变成可量化分析的 finding。Frame as \\\"engineering robustness\\\" in §4; fallback 频率 + tightness 作为 §5 定量分析。\\n\\n**Decidability taxonomy**: Constraints classified by prefix-decidability:\\n- (a) Purely local: entity type ∈ vocabulary (grammar layer)\\n- (b) Prefix-decidable with state: relation argument types compatible with domain/range (semantic layer, requires entity registry)\\n- (c) Truly non-local: forward coreference — out of scope for forward-only decoding\\n\\n### Claim 4 (Methodological): S1 vs S2 Decoding Strategies — Architectural Ablation\\n- S1 (single-pass): Both layers applied throughout generation. **Recommended primary strategy** — simpler, slightly better metrics across the board.\\n- S2 (two-pass): Pass 1 extracts entities (grammar-only), Pass 2 generates relations with input-dependent grammar compiled from Pass 1 entities.\\n\\n**S2 full results (551/551 SciERC)**: DR 0.97% (vs S1 0.93%), CF 8.03% (vs S1 9.9%), R-F1 8.03% (vs S1 8.36%). S2 does NOT solve CF — the 1.87pp reduction is not significant. S2 also slightly worse on DR and F1. **S2 is an architectural variant demonstrating framework flexibility, not a CF solution.** Position in paper as ablation (Section 5 or Appendix), not as a core contribution.\\n\\n⚠️ **Do NOT cite pilot50 DR=0% as S2 evidence** — small-sample artifact; full run shows DR=0.97%. Per-relation S2 DR is worse than S1 on Compare (4.6% vs 2.82%), Part-of (1.25% vs 0%), Used-for (0.12% vs 0%).\\n\\n## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns\\n\\n### C1: \\\"5.78% is barely above 5% — threshold is arbitrary\\\"\\n**Response**: Don't argue about the threshold. Argue about per-relation distribution: Compare (27.6%), Evaluate-for (29.9%), Feature-of (11.3%) have double-digit violation rates with schema-informed prompt. The value proposition is per-relation guaranteed compliance, not overall statistical rate.\\n\\n### C2: \\\"Why not just post-hoc filter?\\\"\\n**Response (D013, 实验结果已出)**:\\n\\nPost-hoc filtering 实验结果：post-hoc F1 > OntoCoDec F1（SciERC 8.63 vs 8.36, DocRED 9.61 vs 8.24）——因 low F1 regime 下移除 FP 大幅提升 precision。\\n\\n**论文 framing（不以 F1 论高低，多维对比）**:\\n1. **Recall 维度（核心论点）**: OntoCoDec recall 上升 (SciERC +0.20pp, DocRED +0.56pp) = 概率质量重分配到合法 token 生效。Post-hoc recall 下降 (SciERC -0.72pp, DocRED -1.06pp) = 正确 triple 被误删。\\n2. **Information coverage**: DocRED post-hoc 丢弃 **48.1%** triples（近半数信息丢失），SciERC 16.8%。OntoCoDec 保留全部 triple slots。\\n3. **Operational**: OntoCoDec 产出即合规、无需后处理、支持流式。Post-hoc 需额外管线、不适用实时场景。\\n4. **Precision trade-off（诚实承认）**: \\\"Post-hoc achieves higher precision by removing a large fraction of triples, many of which are incorrect. This trades information coverage for precision — valid when FP are costly, but inadequate when completeness matters.\\\"\\n\\n数据表：SciERC post-hoc rejection 16.8%, OntoCoDec recall 11.60 vs post-hoc 10.68; DocRED post-hoc rejection 48.1%, OntoCoDec recall 10.02 vs post-hoc 8.40。\\n\\n**Reviewer 补充发现（D013 后）**:\\n5. **ET 残余**：post-hoc 只删 triples 不改 entity list，残余 ET=0.4% (SciERC) / 2.47% (DocRED)。OntoCoDec ET=0%。Post-hoc 无法解决 entity type 违规。\\n6. **127 个被删 TP (DocRED)**：过滤前 TP=1137，过滤后 TP=1010。丢失的 127 个 TP（11.2%）是正确提取但 entity type 违规的 triple。OntoCoDec 通过生成时强制合法 type 保留这些 TP——\\\"prevent vs detect\\\" 核心论据的具体数据。\\n7. **OntoCoDec+post-hoc 组合**（future work idea）：先 constrain 再 filter 残余 DR。低优先级，May 19 前不做。\\n\\n### C3: \\\"Bitwise AND of two masks is not novel\\\"\\n**Response**: The novelty is not the AND operation — it's (a) the automatic compilation from ontology definitions (zero-code schema compliance), (b) the stateful entity registry enabling cross-field constraints during autoregressive generation, (c) the decidability taxonomy providing theoretical guidance, and (d) the systematic violation landscape measurement motivating the approach.\\n\\n### C4: \\\"Evaluate-for violation rate increases with schema-informed prompt\\\"\\n**Response (prior-constraint conflict framework)**: Evaluate-for has 23/36 valid pairs; Method→Task is invalid for Evaluate-for but natural in the LLM's distributional prior (\\\"Method X evaluates for Task Y\\\" is semantically plausible). Schema-informed prompting creates a **prior-constraint conflict**: the model learns to avoid Method→Task for Evaluate-for (reducing count 133→87, -34.6%), but the remaining instances are harder boundary cases where the model's type assignment strategy becomes less stable. This is not just \\\"harder instances\\\" — it's an active interference between prompt-level constraint signals and the model's learned type associations.\\n\\n**This strengthens the paper's claim**: prompt-level intervention is not merely insufficient but potentially **counterproductive** for specific constraint configurations. Decoding-time enforcement avoids this issue entirely — it operates on logits, not on the model's reasoning process, so there is no prior-constraint conflict.\\n\\n### C5: \\\"Only tested on one model (Qwen3-8B)\\\"\\n**Response**: Cross-model validation DONE (D016 bootstrap verified). Llama-3.1-8B 零代码修改：\\n- SciERC: DR 13.34%→0.08% (↓99.4%), R-F1 -0.14pp (p=0.011, negligible), E-F1 NS\\n- DocRED: DR 26.07%→2.55% (↓90.2%), R-F1 +0.29pp (p=0.013, significant), E-F1 -0.64pp (p=0.022, modest decline)\\n- Parse failures: unconstrained 68 vs full_s1 91 (6.8% vs 9.1%)\\n\\n**Cross-model claim 指导（Reviewer 专项评估）**:\\n- ✅ 可声明：\\\"OntoCoDec generalizes across model families without code modification\\\"（程序性事实，铁证）\\n- ❌ 不可声明：\\\"consistently achieves the same reduction rate\\\"（仅 2 模型，不足以量化声明）\\n- **RV↓DR↑ 正交性 finding**: Llama RV baseline 低(16%) 但 DR baseline 高(26%)，反向于 Qwen。证明两层约束解决正交 failure modes——vocabulary compliance ≠ semantic compliance。应作为 §5 cross-model 独立 finding 展开。\\n- **Parse failure 偏差**: checker skip parse failures (不计入 F1)，Llama 68/998=6.8% vs Qwen 12/998=1.2%。偏差方向保守（不利于 constrained），不威胁 claim。但需 footnote 披露 + cross-model 表增加 parse failure rate 行。\\n- **Llama SciERC CF=6.56%**: 比 Qwen 同量级更高，non-local constraint 问题在 Llama 上更突出，limitations 提及。\\n- 等 llama_docred_full_s1 出来后定最终 claim 措辞。\\n\\n### C6: \\\"Constrained decoding degrades generation quality (CRANE, Structure Snowballing)\\\"\\n**Response**: OntoCoDec's semantic constraints are narrower than full grammar constraints — only type tokens are masked, free text is unconstrained. **Bootstrap CI (10000×, D012 Qwen + D016 Llama, all registry-aligned)**:\\n\\n**Qwen3-8B**: SciERC R-F1 +0.13pp (p=0.58, NS), E-F1 -0.03pp (NS). DocRED R-F1 +0.50pp (p<0.001), E-F1 +1.23pp (p<0.001).\\n**Llama-3.1-8B**: SciERC R-F1 -0.14pp (p=0.011, negligible), E-F1 NS. DocRED R-F1 +0.29pp (p=0.013), E-F1 -0.64pp (p=0.022).\\n\\n**Cross-model pattern**: DocRED R-F1 显著提升（两个模型）。E-F1 model-dependent（Qwen +1.23pp, Llama -0.64pp）。\\n- 机制：grammar 消除 OOV relation names + 非标 entity types → all_set 方法下减少 FP → precision 提升。Grammar 是 F1 提升的唯一来源（grammar_only Ent F1=59.38% ≈ full_s1 59.37%, Δ=0.01pp, p=0.66）。Semantic 层对 F1 无额外贡献。\\n- Frame as: \\\"On DocRED, R-F1 gains are significant for both models. Entity F1 impact is model-dependent.\\\"\\n- 不升级为 core claim，但如实报告。\\n\\n### C7: \\\"Your method trades DR violations for CF violations (cross-field consistency)\\\"\\n**Response**: Both S1 and S2 show elevated CF (per-triple rate ~8-10%). This is an inherent limitation of per-relation independent type enforcement. Must be proactively reported as a limitation. Defense:\\n\\n**CF 子类型分析（根因已确认）**：\\n- **EVR（entity-vs-relation type drift）**: 占 CF 的 >90%。同一 entity 在 entity list 和 relation triple 中被赋予不同 type。S1: 245 entities (7.34%), S2: 178 entities (5.54%, -27%)\\n- **Within-rel（同 entity 跨 relation type 不一致）**: S1: 10 (0.36%), S2: 18 (0.72%)\\n- S2 减少 EVR 但增加 within-rel——trade-off 更复杂，不是单纯好/差\\n\\n**Top 冲突模式**: Generic↔OtherScientificTerm (60次), Material↔OtherScientificTerm (28次), Material↔Method (20次)。**这些是 SciERC type system 固有的语义边界模糊区**——同一术语在不同学术语境下确实可以被合理归类为不同 type。CF 在相当程度上是 type system 模糊性的体现，非纯粹的方法缺陷。\\n\\n**论证层次**：\\n1. DR violations = structurally invalid triples（下游系统不可用）→ hard constraint\\n2. CF violations = same entity gets different types across relations → individual triples remain type-valid, only cross-triple consistency broken → soft preference\\n3. CF 的根因是 type system 语义边界模糊 + per-relation 独立 enforcement，非 bug\\n4. Future work: cross-relation global consistency pass (entity-level type consensus before relation-specific enforcement)\\n\\n**机制归因（口径对账确认）**：grammar_only CF=0.08%（与 unconstrained 持平），full_s1 CF=9.90%，full_s2 CF=8.03%。**CF 100% 由 semantic 层引入，grammar 层无贡献。** 这为 \\\"CF 是 semantic type enforcement 的系统性副作用\\\" 提供干净的消融证据。\\n\\n**论文数字口径**：CF rate 用 violation_checker 口径（denominator=total_entities，与 DR/RV/ET 一致）。分析段落额外给 entity-level EVR 率 + 受影响样本比例。注意：analyze_cf 脚本的 EVR/WR 两维度不是独立的（WR⊂EVR），论文中不要作为两个独立维度报告。\\n\\n**Do NOT hide this data.** Proactive disclosure + severity distinction + root cause analysis + type ambiguity evidence + 消融归因 = 最强防御策略。\\n\\n### C8: \\\"Absolute F1 is too low (~8%) — results are not meaningful\\\"\\n**Response**: This is a zero-shot extraction setting (no training data, no fine-tuning). Low F1 is expected — supervised SOTA on SciERC relation F1 is ~40-50%. Our contribution is the constraint enforcement method, not extraction quality. F1 is a control variable verifying constraints don't degrade quality, not an optimization target. Recommended framing: \\\"We evaluate in a zero-shot setting to demonstrate that our constraint enforcement method works without task-specific training. F1 is reported to verify that constraint enforcement does not degrade extraction quality, not as a claim of state-of-the-art performance.\\\"\\n\\n## Paper Structure (Draft)\\n1. Introduction: Violation landscape motivation + composable constraint framework overview\\n2. Background: Grammar-constrained decoding (XGrammar) + IE ontology structure\\n3. Violation Landscape Study (Phase 0 empirics — independent contribution)\\n4. OntoCoDec Framework: Compiler + TypeConstraintProcessor + S1/S2 strategies\\n5. Experiments: Constrained vs unconstrained vs post-hoc vs prompt-based\\n6. Related Work: 5 constraint paradigms (grammar, vocabulary, structural, type-checking, ontology)\\n7. Conclusion\\n\\n## Claim Calibration (per Reviewer assessment)\\n\\n**Safe to claim (sufficient evidence from Phase 2)**:\\n- \\\"First systematic study of ontology constraint violations in LLM-based IE\\\"\\n- \\\"Violation rate correlates with constraint tightness, not ontology size\\\" (D014: DR reduction ceiling 由 tightness × model RV baseline 共同决定)\\n- \\\"Grammar+semantic constrained decoding eliminates 94% of DR violations at zero F1 cost\\\" ✅ Phase 2 confirmed\\n- \\\"Two-layer architecture provides complementary coverage — grammar enables semantic\\\" ✅ Ablation confirmed\\n- \\\"Prompt-level intervention scales poorly with ontology complexity\\\" ✅ SciERC ↓62% vs DocRED ↓32%\\n\\n**Claim with caution**:\\n- \\\"Near-complete type-valid IE\\\" — S1 0.93%, S2 0.97% residual, not truly 0%. Title updated to \\\"Near-Complete\\\"\\n- \\\"Principled framework applicable to arbitrary IE ontologies\\\" — validated on 2 datasets + 1 model only\\n- \\\"F1 improvement\\\" — SciERC: not significant (p=0.58), frame as F1-neutral; DocRED: significant (+0.50pp, p<0.001), 可报告但不升级为 core claim，归因于 OOV elimination 而非约束解码本身的提升\\n- \\\"CF reveals type system ambiguity\\\" — 可在 §5.3 作为 analysis finding 展开（Generic↔OtherScientificTerm 等模式有独立 insight 价值），但 §7 必须同时保留 CF 作为 limitation + future work。**两处都要有，缺一不可。** 不能暗示\\\"因为是 type ambiguity 所以 CF 可接受\\\"\\n\\n**Do NOT claim**:\\n- \\\"General infrastructure for IE\\\" — only zero-shot extraction validated\\n- \\\"State-of-the-art\\\" — F1 is control variable, not optimization target (see C8)\\n- \\\"Synergistic effect\\\" — mechanism is enabling dependency, not mutual amplification (see Claim 3)\\n- \\\"S2 solves CF\\\" or \\\"S2 mitigates Structure Snowballing\\\" — data shows S2 ≈ S1 on all metrics; position as architectural variant only\\n- \\\"Pilot50 DR=0%\\\" — small-sample artifact, full S2 has DR=0.97%\\n- \\\"Grammar-first invariant\\\" 作为独立 claim — 证据不足（仅 1 次崩溃触发，实现是 fallback 非形式化保证）。写入 §4 方法论设计原则（1-2 句），不升级为 claim\\n- \\\"Robust dual-layer composition across schema complexities\\\" — 等 DocRED 完成。最终如 fallback ≤5/998，可写经验性陈述，不做泛化 claim\\n\\n## Risk Ranking (ordered by reject probability)\\n\\n1. **CF violation trade-off under-addressed** (MEDIUM-HIGH): S1 9.9%, S2 8.03% — both elevated. **S2 confirmed: does NOT solve CF.** This is the #1 attack surface. Mitigated by proactive disclosure + severity distinction + root cause analysis (C7). Must be reported as explicit limitation with future work direction (global entity-type consensus).\\n2. ~~**Single model limitation**~~ (RESOLVED): Llama-3.1-8B SciERC ✅ (DR↓99.4%) + DocRED ✅ (DR↓90.2%). 2 模型 × 2 数据集全矩阵完成。\\n3. **Novelty perception** (MEDIUM): \\\"PLDI'25 for code → OntoCoDec for IE\\\" attack line. Must argue IE constraint structure differs fundamentally.\\n4. ~~**DocRED Phase 2 weak**~~ (RESOLVED → reframed as D014): Qwen DR↓44.7%, Llama DR↓90.2% — both substantial. Weaker Qwen reduction explained by RV baseline interaction (D014), not method failure.\\n5. ~~**Phase 2 F1 drop**~~ (RESOLVED): F1 confirmed neutral (SciERC) or positive (DocRED, p<0.001). Bootstrap CI D012 confirms. No longer a risk.\\n\\n## Critical Path to EMNLP Submission (May 25)\\n\\n- **May 13-14**: Phase 0 + Phase 1 + Phase 2 SciERC ✅\\n- **May 14**: Phase 2 DocRED 4-way ablation ✅ + Llama SciERC cross-model ✅ + Dream 完成 (3/6)\\n- **May 14-15**: Llama DocRED 2 组实验 ✅ + Checker 修正 ✅ + post-hoc baseline ✅ + bootstrap CI ✅ + related work ✅\\n- **May 14-15**: D014 tightness claim 修订 + §5 cross-model subsection + abstract/conclusion 修正 (Agent 执行中)\\n- **May 15-17**: 全文校对 + Discussion 整合 + 最终数字确认\\n- **May 19**: 内部稿 → submit_paper_to_review\\n- **May 19-24**: Review 修改 + 最终提交\\n\\n**当前瓶颈**: 无技术 blocker。等 Reviewer 跨文件一致性审查 + 编译验证后即可 submit_paper_to_review。\\n\\n## Status\\n- Phase 0 SciERC: ✅ Complete (minimal + schema-informed)\\n- Phase 0 DocRED: ✅ Complete (minimal 18.7% DR + schema-informed 12.8% DR)\\n- Phase 1 Compiler: ✅ Complete (grammar + semantic layers integrated)\\n- Phase 2 SciERC (5 configs): ✅ Complete (S1 DR↓94% F1-neutral, S2 降级为 ablation)\\n- Phase 2 DocRED (4 configs): ✅ Complete (full_s1 DR↓45%, grammar ET/RV→0%)\\n- Llama SciERC cross-model: ✅ Complete (DR↓99.4%, F1-neutral, 零代码修改)\\n- Llama DocRED cross-model: ✅ Complete (full_s1 DR↓90.2%, unconstrained DR=26.07%)\\n- Checker v2 (D011): ✅ Fixed (ET triple-counting → unique entity dedup)\\n- Bootstrap CI (D012): ✅ Fixed + confirmed (entity filter bug resolved)\\n- Post-hoc baseline (D013): ✅ Complete (multi-dimensional framing)\\n- Related work: ✅ 42 bib entries, 4 additions merged\\n- Dream 6/6 actions: ✅ All complete\\n- CF violation analysis: ✅ Confirmed inherent limitation (S1 9.9% SciERC / 2.57% DocRED / 12.02% Llama DocRED)\\n- D014 tightness revision: ✅ Complete (tightness × RV baseline dual-factor)\\n- Llama bootstrap CI (D016): ✅ Fixed + verified (registry-aligned ≤0.05pp, all p-values in paper)\\n- Paper compilation: ✅ 8 pages正文 + appendix\\n\", \"total_chars\": 20295, \"truncated\": false}, \"error\": null, \"metadata\": {}}"}

Violations are **not uniformly distributed** — they concentrate on relation types with tight domain/range constraints (Feature-of 33.5%, Compare 42.4%) while loose-constraint relations show near-zero violation (Used-for 0.8%).\\n\\n**Key insight**: Violation rate is driven by **constraint tightness**, not ontology size. This trades information coverage for precision — valid when FP are costly, but inadequate when completeness matters.\\\"\\n\\n数据表：SciERC post-hoc rejection 16.8%, OntoCoDec recall 11.60 vs post-hoc 10.68; DocRED post-hoc rejection 48.1%, OntoCoDec recall 10.02 vs post-hoc 8.40。\\n\\n**Reviewer 补充发现（D013 后）**:\\n5. **ET 残余**：post-hoc 只删 triples 不改 entity list，残余 ET=0.4% (SciERC) / 2.47% (DocRED)。OntoCoDec ET=0%。Post-hoc 无法解决 entity type 违规。\\n6. **127 个被删 TP (DocRED)**：过滤前 TP=1137，过滤后 TP=1010。丢失的 127 个 TP（11.2%）是正确提取但 entity type 违规的 triple。OntoCoDec 通过生成时强制合法 type 保留这些 TP——\\\"prevent vs detect\\\" 核心论据的具体数据。\\n7. **OntoCoDec+post-hoc 组合**（future work idea）：先 constrain 再 filter 残余 DR。低优先级，May 19 前不做。\\n\\n### C3: \\\"Bitwise AND of two masks is not novel\\\"\\n**Response**: The novelty is not the AND operation — it's (a) the automatic compilation from ontology definitions (zero-code schema compliance), (b) the stateful entity registry enabling cross-field constraints during autoregressive generation, (c) the decidability taxonomy providing theoretical guidance, and (d) the systematic violation landscape measurement motivating the approach.\\n\\n### C4: \\\"Evaluate-for violation rate increases with schema-informed prompt\\\"\\n**Response (prior-constraint conflict framework)**: Evaluate-for has 23/36 valid pairs; Method→Task is invalid for Evaluate-for but natural in the LLM's distributional prior (\\\"Method X evaluates for Task Y\\\" is semantically plausible). Schema-informed prompting creates a **prior-constraint conflict**: the model learns to avoid Method→Task for Evaluate-for (reducing count 133→87, -34.6%), but the remaining instances are harder boundary cases where the model's type assignment strategy becomes less stable. This is not just \\\"harder instances\\\" — it's an active interference between prompt-level constraint signals and the model's learned type associations.\\n\\n**This strengthens the paper's claim**: prompt-level intervention is not merely insufficient but potentially **counterproductive** for specific constraint configurations. Decoding-time enforcement avoids this issue entirely — it operates on logits, not on the model's reasoning process, so there is no prior-constraint conflict.\\n\\n### C5: \\\"Only tested on one model (Qwen3-8B)\\\"\\n**Response**: Cross-model validation DONE (D016 bootstrap verified). DR violations = structurally invalid triples（下游系统不可用）→ hard constraint\\n2. CF violations = same entity gets different types across relations → individual triples remain type-valid, only cross-triple consistency broken → soft preference\\n3. CF 的根因是 type system 语义边界模糊 + per-relation 独立 enforcement，非 bug\\n4. Future work: cross-relation global consistency pass (entity-level type consensus before relation-specific enforcement)\\n\\n**机制归因（口径对账确认）**：grammar_only CF=0.08%（与 unconstrained 持平），full_s1 CF=9.90%，full_s2 CF=8.03%。**CF 100% 由 semantic 层引入，grammar 层无贡献。** 这为 \\\"CF 是 semantic type enforcement 的系统性副作用\\\" 提供干净的消融证据。\\n\\n**论文数字口径**：CF rate 用 violation_checker 口径（denominator=total_entities，与 DR/RV/ET 一致）。分析段落额外给 entity-level EVR 率 + 受影响样本比例。注意：analyze_cf 脚本的 EVR/WR 两维度不是独立的（WR⊂EVR），论文中不要作为两个独立维度报告。\\n\\n**Do NOT hide this data.** Proactive disclosure + severity distinction + root cause analysis + type ambiguity evidence + 消融归因 = 最强防御策略。\\n\\n### C8: \\\"Absolute F1 is too low (~8%) — results are not meaningful\\\"\\n**Response**: This is a zero-shot extraction setting (no training data, no fine-tuning). ## Target Venue
EMNLP 2026 (ARR submission May 25, 2026)

## Title
OntoCoDec: Type-Valid Information Extraction via Compiled Ontology Constraints
(D015: "Near-Complete" dropped — DocRED residual DR=10.21% (Qwen) 不算 near-complete。论文贡献是方法，不是特定消除率。SciERC 0.93% 和 DocRED 2.55% (Llama) 可在正文中描述为 near-complete，但 title 不宜 overclaim。)

## Core Insight
LLM-based IE systems produce systematic ontology constraint violations concentrated in specific relation types. Prompt-level intervention (schema-informed prompting) reduces violations by ~62% but cannot eliminate them — certain relation types retain 25-30% violation rates even with explicit constraint descriptions. OntoCoDec provides **near-complete elimination (DR 15.4%→0.93%, ↓94%) at zero or positive F1 impact** through automatic ontology-to-decoder constraint compilation with two complementary layers.

**Phase 2 confirmed (D012 bootstrap CI, v2 fix)**: Grammar+Semantic dual-layer constrained decoding reduces domain/range violations by 94%, eliminates entity-type and relation-vocabulary violations entirely (→0%). F1 impact is **dataset-dependent**:
- SciERC: Rel F1 neutral (+0.13pp, p=0.58), Ent F1 neutral (-0.03pp, p=0.53)
- DocRED: Rel F1 **significantly improved** (+0.50pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.23, +0.81]); Ent F1 **significantly improved** (+1.23pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.94, +1.55])
- Mechanism: grammar 消除 OOV relation names (DocRED RV 29.66%→0.03%) + 非标 entity types (ET 2.48%→0%)。all_set F1 方法下 OOV=FP → fewer FP → higher precision/F1。SciERC baseline RV/ET 已很低，效果不显著。
- **Grammar 层是 F1 提升的唯一来源**: grammar_only Ent F1=59.38% ≈ full_s1 59.37% (Δ+0.01pp, p=0.66)。Semantic 层对 F1 无额外贡献，专注 DR reduction。

## Core Claims

### Claim 1 (Empirical): Violation Landscape
LLM-based IE systems violate ontology type constraints at non-trivial rates (15.4% per-triple on SciERC, 18.7% on DocRED). Violations are **not uniformly distributed** — they concentrate on relation types with tight domain/range constraints (Feature-of 33.5%, Compare 42.4%) while loose-constraint relations show near-zero violation (Used-for 0.8%).

**Key insight**: Violation rate is driven by **constraint tightness**, not ontology size. A small ontology with tight constraints can produce more violations than a large ontology with loose constraints.

**D014 修订**: DR reduction ceiling 由 **tightness × model RV baseline** 共同决定，非 tightness 单因素。Llama DocRED DR↓90.2% vs Qwen DR↓44.7%（同一 ontology τ̄=0.842）。机制：Qwen RV=29.66% >> Llama RV=16.03% → grammar 层将 OOV triples 强制匹配有效关系名 → 揭露大量 latent DR violations → 残余 DR 更高。这是比单一 tightness 更深的 insight。

**Evidence**: SciERC (7 relations) 15.4%; DocRED (96 relations) 18.7% — comparable rates despite 14× ontology size difference. Schema-informed prompt on DocRED only achieves DR↓32% (vs SciERC ↓62%), confirming **prompt-level intervention scales poorly with ontology complexity**.

### Claim 2 (Empirical): Prompt Insufficiency
Schema-informed prompting (explicitly describing domain/range constraints in the prompt) reduces but does not eliminate violations:
- Overall: 15.4% → 5.78% (-62.4%), still above 5%
- Per-relation: Compare 42.4% → 27.6%, Evaluate-for 24.1% → 29.9% (**worse**)
- Prompt intervention is unreliable at the per-relation level — some relations improve, one regresses

**Narrative**: This is NOT about "5.78% barely above 5%". The story is: **prompt-level intervention is fundamentally unreliable as a guarantee mechanism**. It works statistically but cannot provide per-instance compliance. Three specific relation types retain >10% violation rates with schema-informed prompts. For safety-critical IE (biomedical, legal, regulatory), statistical reduction is insufficient — guaranteed compliance is required.

### Claim 3 (Methodological): Composable Constraint Framework
OntoCoDec automatically compiles IE ontology schemas into two composable constraint layers:
1. **Grammar layer** (XGrammar): JSON structure + type vocabulary constraints (CFG-expressible)
2. **Semantic layer** (TypeConstraintProcessor): Cross-field domain/range constraints via stateful entity registry + dynamic logit masking

The two layers are **complementary with enabling dependency**: grammar ensures every generated relation type is in the valid vocabulary, which enables the semantic layer to look up and enforce domain/range rules for that type. Without grammar, the semantic layer encounters unknown relation types and cannot enforce constraints (explaining why semantic_only achieves only ↓24% vs full_s1 ↓94%). This is NOT "synergistic" (mutual amplification) — grammar is a prerequisite for semantic, not vice versa.

The two layers compose via bitwise AND of token masks. Recommended framing: "Grammar and semantic constraints compose via bitwise AND with an enabling dependency: grammar ensures structural validity, enabling semantic constraints to enforce domain/range rules. When constraint tightness creates empty intersection between layers, the system degrades gracefully to grammar-only constraints, maintaining structural validity as a guaranteed floor."

**Graceful degradation + Fallback 频率量化** (D008 + Reviewer 发现):
When $M_{semantic} \cap M_{grammar} = \emptyset$, the system falls back to grammar-only control.

**关键量化数据（Reviewer 从日志挖掘）**:
- Llama DocRED full_s1: **32,921 次 fallback / 577 docs = ~57 次/doc**
- Llama SciERC full_s1: **5,882 次 fallback / 550 docs = ~10.7 次/doc**
- DocRED fallback 频率是 SciERC 的 **5.3×**
- Qwen DocRED fallback 率未知（日志当时无 fallback logging，需估算）

**这直接解释了 DocRED DR 残余 10.19% vs SciERC 0.93%**: 更多 token 位置退化为 grammar-only → grammar-only 的 DR 已知为 26.17% → 高 fallback = 高残余 DR。

**论文建议**: 在 §5 tightness 段报告 fallback 率，定义 "Constraint Coverage" 指标（semantic masking 实际生效的 token 比例）。这把 "10.19% DR 残余" 从弱点变成可量化分析的 finding。Frame as "engineering robustness" in §4; fallback 频率 + tightness 作为 §5 定量分析。

**Decidability taxonomy**: Constraints classified by prefix-decidability:
- (a) Purely local: entity type ∈ vocabulary (grammar layer)
- (b) Prefix-decidable with state: relation argument types compatible with domain/range (semantic layer, requires entity registry)
- (c) Truly non-local: forward coreference — out of scope for forward-only decoding

### Claim 4 (Methodological): S1 vs S2 Decoding Strategies — Architectural Ablation
- S1 (single-pass): Both layers applied throughout generation. **Recommended primary strategy** — simpler, slightly better metrics across the board.
- S2 (two-pass): Pass 1 extracts entities (grammar-only), Pass 2 generates relations with input-dependent grammar compiled from Pass 1 entities.

**S2 full results (551/551 SciERC)**: DR 0.97% (vs S1 0.93%), CF 8.03% (vs S1 9.9%), R-F1 8.03% (vs S1 8.36%). S2 does NOT solve CF — the 1.87pp reduction is not significant. S2 also slightly worse on DR and F1. **S2 is an architectural variant demonstrating framework flexibility, not a CF solution.** Position in paper as ablation (Section 5 or Appendix), not as a core contribution.

⚠️ **Do NOT cite pilot50 DR=0% as S2 evidence** — small-sample artifact; full run shows DR=0.97%. Per-relation S2 DR is worse than S1 on Compare (4.6% vs 2.82%), Part-of (1.25% vs 0%), Used-for (0.12% vs 0%).

## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns

### C1: "5.78% is barely above 5% — threshold is arbitrary"
**Response**: Don't argue about the threshold. Argue about per-relation distribution: Compare (27.6%), Evaluate-for (29.9%), Feature-of (11.3%) have double-digit violation rates with schema-informed prompt. The value proposition is per-relation guaranteed compliance, not overall statistical rate.

### C2: "Why not just post-hoc filter?"
**Response (D013, 实验结果已出)**:

Post-hoc filtering 实验结果：post-hoc F1 > OntoCoDec F1（SciERC 8.63 vs 8.36, DocRED 9.61 vs 8.24）——因 low F1 regime 下移除 FP 大幅提升 precision。

**论文 framing（不以 F1 论高低，多维对比）**:
1. **Recall 维度（核心论点）**: OntoCoDec recall 上升 (SciERC +0.20pp, DocRED +0.56pp) = 概率质量重分配到合法 token 生效。Post-hoc recall 下降 (SciERC -0.72pp, DocRED -1.06pp) = 正确 triple 被误删。
2. **Information coverage**: DocRED post-hoc 丢弃 **48.1%** triples（近半数信息丢失），SciERC 16.8%。OntoCoDec 保留全部 triple slots。
3. **Operational**: OntoCoDec 产出即合规、无需后处理、支持流式。Post-hoc 需额外管线、不适用实时场景。
4. **Precision trade-off（诚实承认）**: "Post-hoc achieves higher precision by removing a large fraction of triples, many of which are incorrect. This trades information coverage for precision — valid when FP are costly, but inadequate when completeness matters."

数据表：SciERC post-hoc rejection 16.8%, OntoCoDec recall 11.60 vs post-hoc 10.68; DocRED post-hoc rejection 48.1%, OntoCoDec recall 10.02 vs post-hoc 8.40。

**Reviewer 补充发现（D013 后）**:
5. **ET 残余**：post-hoc 只删 triples 不改 entity list，残余 ET=0.4% (SciERC) / 2.47% (DocRED)。OntoCoDec ET=0%。Post-hoc 无法解决 entity type 违规。
6. **127 个被删 TP (DocRED)**：过滤前 TP=1137，过滤后 TP=1010。丢失的 127 个 TP（11.2%）是正确提取但 entity type 违规的 triple。OntoCoDec 通过生成时强制合法 type 保留这些 TP——"prevent vs detect" 核心论据的具体数据。
7. **OntoCoDec+post-hoc 组合**（future work idea）：先 constrain 再 filter 残余 DR。低优先级，May 19 前不做。

### C3: "Bitwise AND of two masks is not novel"
**Response**: The novelty is not the AND operation — it's (a) the automatic compilation from ontology definitions (zero-code schema compliance), (b) the stateful entity registry enabling cross-field constraints during autoregressive generation, (c) the decidability taxonomy providing theoretical guidance, and (d) the systematic violation landscape measurement motivating the approach.

### C4: "Evaluate-for violation rate increases with schema-informed prompt"
**Response (prior-constraint conflict framework)**: Evaluate-for has 23/36 valid pairs; Method→Task is invalid for Evaluate-for but natural in the LLM's distributional prior ("Method X evaluates for Task Y" is semantically plausible). Schema-informed prompting creates a **prior-constraint conflict**: the model learns to avoid Method→Task for Evaluate-for (reducing count 133→87, -34.6%), but the remaining instances are harder boundary cases where the model's type assignment strategy becomes less stable. This is not just "harder instances" — it's an active interference between prompt-level constraint signals and the model's learned type associations.

**This strengthens the paper's claim**: prompt-level intervention is not merely insufficient but potentially **counterproductive** for specific constraint configurations. Decoding-time enforcement avoids this issue entirely — it operates on logits, not on the model's reasoning process, so there is no prior-constraint conflict.

### C5: "Only tested on one model (Qwen3-8B)"
**Response**: Cross-model validation DONE (D016 bootstrap verified). Llama-3.1-8B 零代码修改：
- SciERC: DR 13.34%→0.08% (↓99.4%), R-F1 -0.14pp (p=0.011, negligible), E-F1 NS
- DocRED: DR 26.07%→2.55% (↓90.2%), R-F1 +0.29pp (p=0.013, significant), E-F1 -0.64pp (p=0.022, modest decline)
- Parse failures: unconstrained 68 vs full_s1 91 (6.8% vs 9.1%)

**Cross-model claim 指导（Reviewer 专项评估）**:
- ✅ 可声明："OntoCoDec generalizes across model families without code modification"（程序性事实，铁证）
- ❌ 不可声明："consistently achieves the same reduction rate"（仅 2 模型，不足以量化声明）
- **RV↓DR↑ 正交性 finding**: Llama RV baseline 低(16%) 但 DR baseline 高(26%)，反向于 Qwen。证明两层约束解决正交 failure modes——vocabulary compliance ≠ semantic compliance。应作为 §5 cross-model 独立 finding 展开。
- **Parse failure 偏差**: checker skip parse failures (不计入 F1)，Llama 68/998=6.8% vs Qwen 12/998=1.2%。偏差方向保守（不利于 constrained），不威胁 claim。但需 footnote 披露 + cross-model 表增加 parse failure rate 行。
- **Llama SciERC CF=6.56%**: 比 Qwen 同量级更高，non-local constraint 问题在 Llama 上更突出，limitations 提及。
- 等 llama_docred_full_s1 出来后定最终 claim 措辞。

### C6: "Constrained decoding degrades generation quality (CRANE, Structure Snowballing)"
**Response**: OntoCoDec's semantic constraints are narrower than full grammar constraints — only type tokens are masked, free text is unconstrained. **Bootstrap CI (10000×, D012 Qwen + D016 Llama, all registry-aligned)**:

**Qwen3-8B**: SciERC R-F1 +0.13pp (p=0.58, NS), E-F1 -0.03pp (NS). DocRED R-F1 +0.50pp (p<0.001), E-F1 +1.23pp (p<0.001).
**Llama-3.1-8B**: SciERC R-F1 -0.14pp (p=0.011, negligible), E-F1 NS. DocRED R-F1 +0.29pp (p=0.013), E-F1 -0.64pp (p=0.022).

**Cross-model pattern**: DocRED R-F1 显著提升（两个模型）。E-F1 model-dependent（Qwen +1.23pp, Llama -0.64pp）。
- 机制：grammar 消除 OOV relation names + 非标 entity types → all_set 方法下减少 FP → precision 提升。Grammar 是 F1 提升的唯一来源（grammar_only Ent F1=59.38% ≈ full_s1 59.37%, Δ=0.01pp, p=0.66）。Semantic 层对 F1 无额外贡献。
- Frame as: "On DocRED, R-F1 gains are significant for both models. Entity F1 impact is model-dependent."
- 不升级为 core claim，但如实报告。

### C7: "Your method trades DR violations for CF violations (cross-field consistency)"
**Response**: Both S1 and S2 show elevated CF (per-triple rate ~8-10%). This is an inherent limitation of per-relation independent type enforcement. Must be proactively reported as a limitation. Defense:

**CF 子类型分析（根因已确认）**：
- **EVR（entity-vs-relation type drift）**: 占 CF 的 >90%。同一 entity 在 entity list 和 relation triple 中被赋予不同 type。S1: 245 entities (7.34%), S2: 178 entities (5.54%, -27%)
- **Within-rel（同 entity 跨 relation type 不一致）**: S1: 10 (0.36%), S2: 18 (0.72%)
- S2 减少 EVR 但增加 within-rel——trade-off 更复杂，不是单纯好/差

**Top 冲突模式**: Generic↔OtherScientificTerm (60次), Material↔OtherScientificTerm (28次), Material↔Method (20次)。**这些是 SciERC type system 固有的语义边界模糊区**——同一术语在不同学术语境下确实可以被合理归类为不同 type。CF 在相当程度上是 type system 模糊性的体现，非纯粹的方法缺陷。

**论证层次**：
1. DR violations = structurally invalid triples（下游系统不可用）→ hard constraint
2. CF violations = same entity gets different types across relations → individual triples remain type-valid, only cross-triple consistency broken → soft preference
3. CF 的根因是 type system 语义边界模糊 + per-relation 独立 enforcement，非 bug
4. Future work: cross-relation global consistency pass (entity-level type consensus before relation-specific enforcement)

**机制归因（口径对账确认）**：grammar_only CF=0.08%（与 unconstrained 持平），full_s1 CF=9.90%，full_s2 CF=8.03%。**CF 100% 由 semantic 层引入，grammar 层无贡献。** 这为 "CF 是 semantic type enforcement 的系统性副作用" 提供干净的消融证据。

**论文数字口径**：CF rate 用 violation_checker 口径（denominator=total_entities，与 DR/RV/ET 一致）。分析段落额外给 entity-level EVR 率 + 受影响样本比例。注意：analyze_cf 脚本的 EVR/WR 两维度不是独立的（WR⊂EVR），论文中不要作为两个独立维度报告。

**Do NOT hide this data.** Proactive disclosure + severity distinction + root cause analysis + type ambiguity evidence + 消融归因 = 最强防御策略。

### C8: "Absolute F1 is too low (~8%) — results are not meaningful"
**Response**: This is a zero-shot extraction setting (no training data, no fine-tuning). Low F1 is expected — supervised SOTA on SciERC relation F1 is ~40-50%. Our contribution is the constraint enforcement method, not extraction quality. F1 is a control variable verifying constraints don't degrade quality, not an optimization target. Recommended framing: "We evaluate in a zero-shot setting to demonstrate that our constraint enforcement method works without task-specific training. F1 is reported to verify that constraint enforcement does not degrade extraction quality, not as a claim of state-of-the-art performance."

2. Background: Grammar-constrained decoding (XGrammar) + IE ontology structure
3. Violation Landscape Study (Phase 0 empirics — independent contribution)
4. OntoCoDec Framework: Compiler + TypeConstraintProcessor + S1/S2 strategies
5. Experiments: Constrained vs unconstrained vs post-hoc vs prompt-based
6. Related Work: 5 constraint paradigms (grammar, vocabulary, structural, type-checking, ontology)
7. Conclusion

## Claim Calibration (per Reviewer assessment)

**Safe to claim (sufficient evidence from Phase 2)**:

- "Violation rate correlates with constraint tightness, not ontology size" (D014: DR reduction ceiling 由 tightness × model RV baseline 共同决定)

- "F1 improvement" — SciERC: not significant (p=0.58), frame as F1-neutral; DocRED: significant (+0.50pp, p<0.001), 可报告但不升级为 core claim，归因于 OOV elimination 而非约束解码本身的提升
- "CF reveals type system ambiguity" — 可在 §5.3 作为 analysis finding 展开（Generic↔OtherScientificTerm 等模式有独立 insight 价值），但 §7 必须同时保留 CF 作为 limitation + future work。**两处都要有，缺一不可。** 不能暗示"因为是 type ambiguity 所以 CF 可接受"

**Do NOT claim**:
- "General infrastructure for IE" — only zero-shot extraction validated
- "State-of-the-art" — F1 is control variable, not optimization target (see C8)
- "Synergistic effect" — mechanism is enabling dependency, not mutual amplification (see Claim 3)
- "S2 solves CF" or "S2 mitigates Structure Snowballing" — data shows S2 ≈ S1 on all metrics; position as architectural variant only
- "Pilot50 DR=0%" — small-sample artifact, full S2 has DR=0.97%
- "Grammar-first invariant" 作为独立 claim — 证据不足（仅 1 次崩溃触发，实现是 fallback 非形式化保证）。写入 §4 方法论设计原则（1-2 句），不升级为 claim
- "Robust dual-layer composition across schema complexities" — 等 DocRED 完成。最终如 fallback ≤5/998，可写经验性陈述，不做泛化 claim

## Risk Ranking (ordered by reject probability)

## OntoCoDec Experiment Plan
## Target: EMNLP 2026 ARR (May 25, 2026)
## Last updated: 2026-05-14

claims:
  C1_violation_landscape:
    description: "LLM-based IE violates ontology type constraints at non-trivial rates; violation rate driven by constraint tightness × model RV baseline, not ontology size"
    status: supported
    evidence_strength: strong

  C2_prompt_insufficiency:
    description: "Schema-informed prompting reduces but cannot eliminate violations; unreliable per-relation"
    status: supported
    evidence_strength: strong

  C3_composable_framework:
    description: "OntoCoDec compiles IE ontology schemas into two composable constraint layers (grammar+semantic) with enabling dependency; near-complete DR elimination"
    status: supported
    evidence_strength: strong

  C4_s1_vs_s2:
    description: "S2 two-pass offers no advantage over S1 single-pass; S1 adopted as primary"
    status: supported_demoted
    evidence_strength: moderate
    note: "S2 demoted to ablation (D007). S1 simpler + marginally better F1."

  C5_cross_model:
    description: "OntoCoDec generalizes across models without code modification; DR reduction magnitude varies with model RV baseline"
    status: supported
    evidence_strength: strong

  C6_f1_impact:
    description: "Constraint enforcement preserves or improves F1; improvement is model/dataset-dependent (Qwen DocRED significant, SciERC neutral)"
    status: supported
    evidence_strength: strong

experiments:
  # --- Phase 0: Violation Landscape (ALL COMPLETE) ---
  - plan_id: P001
    name: SciERC violation rate (minimal prompt)
    claim: C1_violation_landscape
    registry_id: mvp_phase0_violation_rate
    priority: 1
    result: "DR=15.4%, 1724 triples"

  - plan_id: P002
    name: SciERC violation rate (schema-informed prompt)
    claim: C2_prompt_insufficiency
    registry_id: mvp_phase0_scierc_schema
    priority: 1
    result: "DR=5.78%, -62.4% reduction, Evaluate-for regression"

  - plan_id: P003

    result: "DR=18.7%, RV=28.9%"

  - plan_id: P004
    name: DocRED violation rate (schema-informed prompt)
    claim: C2_prompt_insufficiency
    registry_id: mvp_phase0_docred_schema
    priority: 1
    result: "DR=12.8%, -32% reduction (weaker than SciERC)"

  # --- Phase 2: SciERC Ablation (ALL COMPLETE) ---
  - plan_id: P005a
    name: SciERC unconstrained baseline
    claim: C3_composable_framework
    registry_id: phase2_scierc_unconstrained
    priority: 1
    result: "DR=15.37%, RV=1.39%, ET=0.40%, R-F1=8.23%"

  - plan_id: P005
    name: SciERC grammar-only
    claim: C3_composable_framework
    registry_id: phase2_scierc_grammar_only
    priority: 1
    result: "RV→0%, ET→0%, DR=14.84% (grammar alone doesn't reduce DR), E-F1=30.98%"

# OntoCoDec — Paper Framing

## Target Venue
EMNLP 2026 (ARR submission May 25, 2026)

## Title
OntoCoDec: Type-Valid Information Extraction via Compiled Ontology Constraints
(D015: "Near-Complete" dropped — DocRED residual DR=10.21% (Qwen) 不算 near-complete。论文贡献是方法，不是特定消除率。SciERC 0.93% 和 DocRED 2.55% (Llama) 可在正文中描述为 near-complete，但 title 不宜 overclaim。)

## Core Insight
LLM-based IE systems produce systematic ontology constraint violations concentrated in specific relation types. Prompt-level intervention (schema-informed prompting) reduces violations by ~62% but cannot eliminate them — certain relation types retain 25-30% violation rates even with explicit constraint descriptions. OntoCoDec provides **near-complete elimination (DR 15.4%→0.93%, ↓94%) at zero or positive F1 impact** through automatic ontology-to-decoder constraint compilation with two complementary layers.

**Phase 2 confirmed (D012 bootstrap CI, v2 fix)**: Grammar+Semantic dual-layer constrained decoding reduces domain/range violations by 94%, eliminates entity-type and relation-vocabulary violations entirely (→0%). F1 impact is **dataset-dependent**:
- SciERC: Rel F1 neutral (+0.13pp, p=0.58), Ent F1 neutral (-0.03pp, p=0.53)
- DocRED: Rel F1 **significantly improved** (+0.50pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.23, +0.81]); Ent F1 **significantly improved** (+1.23pp, p<0.001, 95% CI [+0.94, +1.55])
- Mechanism: grammar 消除 OOV relation names (DocRED RV 29.66%→0.03%) + 非标 entity types (ET 2.48%→0%)。all_set F1 方法下 OOV=FP → fewer FP → higher precision/F1。SciERC baseline RV/ET 已很低，效果不显著。
- **Grammar 层是 F1 提升的唯一来源**: grammar_only Ent F1=59.38% ≈ full_s1 59.37% (Δ+0.01pp, p=0.66)。Semantic 层对 F1 无额外贡献，专注 DR reduction。

## Core Claims

### Claim 1 (Empirical): Violation Landscape

Violations are **not uniformly distributed** — they concentrate on relation types with tight domain/range constraints (Feature-of 33.5%, Compare 42.4%) while loose-constraint relations show near-zero violation (Used-for 0.8%).

**Evidence**: SciERC (7 relations) 15.4%; DocRED (96 relations) 18.7% — comparable rates despite 14× ontology size difference. Schema-informed prompt on DocRED only achieves DR↓32% (vs SciERC ↓62%), confirming **prompt-level intervention scales poorly with ontology complexity**.

## 补充 — Llama-DocRED F1 差异根因确认

[severity: info] 根因已核实：**parse failure 处理差异**，非计算 bug。

证据：
1. SciERC（0 parse failures）：bootstrap point estimate 与 registry **完全相同**（4 个值均精确匹配至小数点后 4 位）

**结论**：
- 差异源于 parse failure docs 是否进入 gold 分母，不影响 paired delta 的统计有效性
